messages.text: BL-1673 🎵 in progress — lane-running? (lane_process_lib.bb, BL-1652) counts the process that is doing the scanning: a probe whose own argv both matches the lane pattern and names the worktree reads true, and under a Stryker sandbox every bb the tests spawn has its load-file path under .stryker-tmp/, which (?i)stryker matches - so bl1652HandoffdRespawnReadingsWiring's 'a role-info with no matching lane process reads false' is red on every extension mutation dry run (hardener sighting on BL-1640, twice, deterministic; green under plain vitest; three-way probe below); the scan skips its own pid, the wiring probe passes its form through a file, and one case pins the sandbox-shaped argv
